players.name: Cal Raleigh
players.summary: Raleigh exited in the 9th inning with right-side soreness in a 4-3 extra-inning Mariners loss to Houston; imaging results pending. An IL stint appears possible given he missed 3 games with the same issue earlier this month.

sources.title: Mariners' Cal Raleigh: Removed with injury
Cal Raleigh exits with injury in Mariners 4-3 loss

players.name: Bryce Harper
players.summary: Harper returned fully healthy after missing May 9 with a migraine and went 0-for-4 in Wednesday's 3-1 Phillies loss at Fenway. No injury concerns.

sources.title: Phillies vs Red Sox May 13 box score

players.name: Luis Arraez
players.summary: Arraez went 2-for-3 with a walk as Shohei Ohtani shut out the Giants 4-0. He is healthy and batting .312, continuing his elite contact approach.

sources.title: Giants vs Dodgers May 13 box score

players.name: Bo Bichette
players.summary: Bichette delivered a clutch 1-for-4 showing with an RBI single in the 7th to tie the game at 2-2, as the Mets walked off the Tigers 3-2 in 10 innings. Healthy and productive.

sources.title: Tigers squander late lead, lose on Mets walk-off

players.name: Lindor/McGonigle
players.summary: Kevin McGonigle drew three walks and stole a base in a tough 3-2 extra-inning loss to the Mets at Citi Field. He now has 24 walks to only 22 strikeouts on the season—remarkable plate discipline for a 21-year-old rookie.

sources.title: Mets 3, Tigers 2 (F/10) recap — Bless You Boys

players.name: Pete Crow-Armstrong
players.summary: PCA notched a hit and stole his 10th base in a 4-1 Cubs loss to the Braves, extending his hitting streak to 7 games. He is slashing .255/.321/.400 with 4 HR, 17 RBI, and 10 SB.

sources.title: Enhanced Box Score: Braves 4, Cubs 1 — May 13, 2026

players.name: Jackson Merrill
players.summary: Merrill took his first scheduled day off since September 1 after going 2-for-5 in Tuesday's 5-4 extra-inning win over the Brewers. He is healthy and back to full strength after returning from a brief IL stint.

players.name: Teoscar Hernandez
players.summary: Hernández went 2-for-3 with a double, walk, and RBI single as the Dodgers blanked the Giants 4-0 behind Ohtani. Manager Dave Roberts said he is giving Hernández extended opportunities to work through his early-season slump—Wednesday was a step in the right direction.

sources.title: Dodgers' Dave Roberts explains Teoscar Hernandez decision vs. Giants
Giants vs Dodgers May 13 box score

players.name: Stanton/Rice
players.summary: Ben Rice drew a walk but went 0-for-3 as the Yankees were shut out 7-0 by the Orioles. Rice had hit his 13th HR on May 12; he is healthy but working through a brief slump after the Baltimore series.

sources.title: Yankees vs Orioles May 13 box score

players.name: Devin Williams
players.summary: Williams has now pitched six consecutive scoreless outings and earned his 3rd win of the season Wednesday (1.0 IP, 0 H, 0 ER in the 9th). His resurgence is tied to his pitching coach's adjustments to his airbender grip.

sources.title: Mets' Devin Williams finding his groove in 2026

players.name: Zack Wheeler
players.summary: Wheeler's May 12 start was historically efficient: 7⅓ IP, 1 ER, 6 H, 4 K, 0 BB on just 87 pitches — fewest through 3 innings by any starter since 2000. He did not pitch Wednesday and takes his next regular turn.

sources.title: Zack Wheeler accomplishes feat not done this century vs Red Sox

players.name: Cole Ragans
players.summary: Ragans is on the 15-day IL (retroactive May 7) with left elbow impingement/valgus extension overload after exiting his May 7 start vs Cleveland in just 3 innings. Given his two prior Tommy John surgeries the Royals are being cautious; manager Quatraro is cautiously optimistic about a minimal IL stay.

sources.title: Royals Place Cole Ragans On IL With Elbow Impingement — MLB Trade Rumors
Cole Ragans placed on Injured List — Royals Review

players.name: Chase Burns
players.summary: Burns started in a wild 8-7 Nationals extra-inning win; the Reds built a 5-run lead before the bullpen collapsed and Daylen Lile hit a walk-off 2-run HR in the 10th. Burns gets a no-decision despite solid work and remains among the NL ERA leaders.

players.name: Nathan Eovaldi
players.summary: Eovaldi threw a bullpen session Wednesday and said he felt good two days after being scratched from his May 11 start with left side tightness. Manager Schumaker will consult medical staff before confirming his next start, tentatively targeting his regular turn.

sources.title: Rangers starter Eovaldi feels good in bullpen 2 days after tightness

players.name: Emmet Sheehan
players.summary: Sheehan did not pitch Wednesday — Shohei Ohtani took the mound for the Dodgers in a 4-0 shutout of the Giants. Sheehan has been working on his mechanics after a velocity dip early in 2026; he will slot into the rotation on his regular turn.

sources.title: Emmet Sheehan Works on Mechanics as Velocity Dips in 2026

players.name: Reid Detmers
players.summary: Detmers fell to 1-4 after a rough 5⅔-inning outing (3 ER, 6 K) in a 4-2 loss to the Guardians; he has historically struggled at Progressive Field (0-2, 7.08 ERA in career). The Angels have now lost 11 of 12 road games.

injuries.name: Cal Raleigh
injuries.note: Removed in 9th inning May 13 vs HOU; Mariners awaiting imaging results; IL stint possible given same-area issues earlier this month

injuries.note: Retroactive to May 7; valgus extension overload diagnosis; two prior Tommy John surgeries; minimal IL stay expected per manager Quatraro

injuries.name: Nathan Eovaldi
injuries.note: Scratched May 11 vs ARI; bullpen session May 13 went well; next start timing TBD pending medical staff review
